knownProductLimitationAtAuditedBuild.name: export-cache freshness
knownProductLimitationAtAuditedBuild.detail: Qpo modal initializes legacy stored artifact using document/source/IR/revision/width/scope identity without exact current renderer content. A later cache freshness fix is in progress and requires its own build/browser evidence. The three fresh service exports audited here have exact current scene/content bindings.

limitations: No inherited 39-case matrix coverage, native interaction/performance result, participant trial, human aesthetic acceptance or journal-publication certification.
Only two already prepared input documents, nine Qpo public-DOM observations and three actual exports were audited.

Source and full input CanvasDocuments match prepared baselines; all nine observed main Canvas XML match exact current interactive renders, establishing visible frontier/geometry and metadata equality for those observations. No separate persisted-document capture at every UI step is present.

Compact journal state contains focus/no-AX-change summaries rather than a saved complete accessibility tree at each step. Invalid width has DOM message/no-preview/no-links evidence; generator disabled state is not a separately recorded DOM field.
XML comparison normalizes attribute ordering and decoded metadata representation but requires all tag/attribute/text/tail/child values exact; no geometric tolerance is used for Canvas or preview XML.

SVG converter serializes physical height with 8 significant digits: actual 263.70029 and 309.47899 mm differ from full scene metadata by 0.000001815562 and 0.000001596639 mm; exact converter bytes are verified, physical serialization tolerance is 0.00005 mm.

PDF actual single-page MediaBox is checked against independent mm-to-point formula within 0.05 pt and exact recorded receipt values; PDF pixels/font shaping/embedding were not independently visually certified.

All nine associated final screenshots plus two opened-SVG screenshots were viewed. Three screenshots lag their same-name DOM target state. Initial intermediate screenshots were deliberately excluded and not viewed.
Text widths are deterministic estimates; Unicode code-point fallback is not grapheme/shaping or font-fidelity certification.
Standalone report resides in /tmp and was present/hash-verified at audit time; durable log/hash binding exists here but independent-copy package is not itself a permanent deliverable.
